description: This file defines a migration class for a specific version of the OrangeHRM system. The class is part of the migration subsystem and specifies the version but contains no database change logic in the 'up' method.

classes.description: A migration class representing version 4.2.0.1 of the OrangeHRM system, extending the abstract migration base class.
